answers.core: Ensuring the coordinates of a collision polygon are precisely accurate after roughly blocking them out with a visual editor seems like it would be a common action to me, and requiring an external add-on to expose this basic information introduces more friction to the process than just having it in core.
answers.workaround: It can be worked around by opening the resource file in a text editor and modifying the PackedVector2Array there, but finding the polygon of interest may be difficult.

title: Expose TileSet physics polygon vertex locations in editor
